proposal_rules.title: Add Recipient Resolution Gate for Outbound Email Tasks
proposal_rules.hypothesis: When an email task specifies only a human name, agents may guess a synthetic address and over-claim success; requiring unique contact/email resolution before outbox writes will prevent false `OUTCOME_OK` results.
proposal_rules.change: Add a small outbound-email rule: before writing `outbox/*.json`, resolve the recipient to a concrete email from existing repo records (prefer `contacts/*.json`). If the task provides only a name and no unique resolvable email/contact, do not invent an address and return `OUTCOME_NONE_CLARIFICATION` instead of `OUTCOME_OK`.
